messages:
Ivy (sales): NorthBridge POC reporting repeated SSE disconnects. Mobile app shows partial JSON events and a crash in the parser. Need a fast triage.
Arman (eng): Hosted endpoint or dedicated? SDK or custom client? Any logs?
Ivy (sales): Hosted. They use Redwood Android SDK v1.4.5 and a lightweight web client. Logs attached (sanitized).
Sofia (devex): Common pattern: carrier/edge or CDN buffering splits multibyte UTF-8 across chunks. Can you paste the raw recv fragment and response headers?
Ivy (sales): Fragment from Android: 
"recv: "data: {\"note\": \"Sé\"\n"
Parse error: unexpected EOF

Headers when it failed: x-request-id: nb-4432, x-rate-limit-remaining: 0, x-rate-limit-reset: 8

Jules (solutions): That x-rate-limit looks suspicious. If they hit a short 429 then immediate reconnects can cause flood and upstream closes. Two prongs: prevent reassembly issues and stop reconnect stampede.
Arman (eng): Server fixes: emit SSE keepalive comments every 10s (":\n\n"), call flush after events, set headers: `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, `Cache-Control: no-transform`. For CloudFront, set origin to preserve chunked responses.
Sofia (devex): Client hardening: buffer bytes and only parse when you see "\n\n". For UTF-8, use a streaming decoder that waits for full code points. Example: accumulate ByteBuffer, attempt decode, if MalformedInputException, wait for next chunk. Also exponential backoff with randomized jitter for reconnects.
Ivy (sales): NorthBridge says most failures happen on low-signal cellular and after a 429. They can try the buffering change client-side quickly. Would infra be able to spin a temporary dedicated ingress to avoid CloudFront for the POC?
Arman (eng): We can spin a short-lived dedicated route in ~24h pending finance signoff. I'll open the infra ticket. For immediate testing, try sending `: \n\n` keepalives and disable CDN buffering on their edge.
traffic-bot: Observability: saw 18 SSE disconnects for nb-4432 in last hour, 3 occurrences of 429 within 60s windows.
Jules (solutions): Also recommend adding small server-side event batching boundary marker (e.g., send a comment line with event-id) so clients can detect incomplete events more robustly.
Ivy (sales): I'll push the client buffering snippet to NorthBridge and request a curl -v capture with `--raw`. Will update with traces. Thanks all :pray:
Arman (eng): Thanks  once we have a raw capture I'll correlate with gateway logs and follow up with a triage runbook.
